class: A searchable education subject commits a highlighted or unrelated row
symptom: Both Waystar education fields showed Accounting despite the profile subjects.
root_cause: The education adapter enabled keyboard fallback and accepted any committed chip. It ignored approved subject substitutes and only inspected the first virtualized rows; relocating the input also changed positional lookup order.
why_tests_missed: Fixtures lacked virtualized option windows, input relocation, and wrong committed chips.
fix: Use exact offered-option clicks and approved alternatives; preserve stable input identity, read only its associated popup, scroll later rows, and verify the committed label. Prefer explicit profile subjects over older extraction.
prevention: Verify committed subject identity and existing attachment evidence across resumed runs rather than counting keystrokes or empty input values.
